# Project cover provenance

- Cliffside Conquest: actual frame at 00:43 from `assets/videos/CliffsideConquest.mp4`; cropped to the 1160×650 gameplay viewport at x=262, y=49. No generated game imagery.
- Digital Twin: actual frame at 00:10 from `assets/videos/GeolocationService.mp4`; cropped to the 568×302 map viewport at x=100, y=604. The original recording limits detail; the full video remains available on the project page.
- Compiler Construction: original SVG illustration of source code, parsing, and AST construction. Illustrative, not a screenshot.
- Live Train Status: original SVG illustration of route/schedule relationships and relational data. Illustrative, not live train information.
- KXR Smithy: original SVG illustration of a virtual anvil, hammer, and hand interaction, informed by the existing simulation video. Illustrative, not a rendered screenshot from the application.

Code Buddy and CabinAI retain their existing HTML/SVG project artwork.
